industry.structure: U.S. managed care for government programs is concentrated among national insurers (UnitedHealth, Centene, Elevance, CVS/Aetna, Cigna). Scale drives state RFP wins and pharmacy purchasing power; Medicaid and Medicare rates are set by regulators, so margin depends on medical-cost management more than pricing power.
industry.share_shift: Centene leads Medicaid and Marketplace membership but lost members during post-PHE redeterminations; Marketplace gains partially offset Medicaid exits. Medicare Advantage share is growing among dual-eligible populations where Centene has peer-leading concentration.
industry.trend: Medical-cost trend, Medicaid redetermination mix, Medicare Advantage rate notices, and Marketplace subsidy policy are the live industry variables; insurers with heavy government-program exposure face higher headline volatility when HBR spikes.
